text:
claire: Idea: run a 'Popcorn Passport' recognition tour next month. Employees get a mini passport card; each spot-award stamp = small snack + the chance to enter a monthly draw. Low cost, playful. Thoughts on policy and ops?

rachel: Cute! How small is 'small snack' budget-wise? Also do we need manager sign-off per award?

josh: Suggest $30 per stamp (single-serving popcorn or a snack). Manager approval optional but we should log who issued it.

priya: Quick tax/legal check: for US, gifts under $100 may be de minimis but company policy prefers tracking anything redeemable for cash/raffles. I'll loop in legal for review.

legal-bot: FYI from Legal: raffle entries can change tax treatment. Recommend keeping prize entry value low and documenting participants. Also keep a waiver link for raffles.

claire: Good call. Plan: passport card (wallet size) with 4 stamp slots. Each stamp = snack. After 4 stamps, employee can submit for raffle entry (digital form). We'll offer 3 small raffles (gift cards <$75).

rachel: Logistics: need printers for 250 passports + a custom stamp (rubber). Cost estimate: passports $45, stamps $30, snacks $200 across two offices = ~$275. Approvals?

josh: Can hospitality cover snack procurement? They have vendor credits. If yes we only need $75 for misc supplies.

priya: I'll confirm vendor credits. Also: retention policy for collection logs? We should only store name, date, issuer, and whether they opted into raffle. Purge after 1 year.

claire: I'll draft a one-paragraph blurb for comms: where/when, what passport is, how to get a stamp, raffle details, privacy note.

ops-bot: Created draft calendar series: "Popcorn Passport Tour" Tue/Wed 11:451:00 for next two weeks. Rooms: SF floors 3,4,7 and NYC floor 5. Link: https://calendar.company/internal/pp-tour

josh: Volunteers? I can take SF Wed 12:00 slot. Tom can do NYC Tue. Who's on SF Mon?

priya: I can cover SF Mon 11:452:15. Claire can do final check Friday before kickoff.

legal-bot: Also recommend signage: "Participation is voluntary. Raffle entries will be used only for prize distribution and reporting." I'll attach a short opt-in wording later.

rachel: One more: how do we handle remote employees? Can we mail a single snack pack + a digital stamp (we can issue a code they paste into the digital form)?

claire: Yes — we'll add a digital code workflow. Remote folks request a code via the form and ops will mail a snack pack if requested. Add cost estimate $20/month for remote mailouts.

josh: Tracking: use a shared sheet with columns: `date, passport_id, recipient_email, issuer, in_office, raffle_opt_in`. Priya to own data retention.

priya: Will set up a Google Sheet and a simple Google Form for raffle opt-ins. I'll add the privacy blurb.

claire: Comms blurb draft: "Introducing Popcorn Passport 11 collect stamps for tiny treats and enter a monthly raffle. Tour visits SF & NYC next two weeks. Scan QR at the cart to log your stamp or request a remote code. See calendar to sign up for volunteer shifts." Thoughts?

rachel: Add emoji :passport: :popcorn: and a link to policy. Otherwise LGTM.

ops-bot: Reminder set: "Order passport cards + stamps" for Monday 09:00.

priya: Action items: claire -> comms blurb + FAQ; rachel -> hospitality coordination + budget sign-off; josh -> volunteers; tom -> stamp pickup; priya -> sheet/form + privacy text; legal-bot -> opt-in blurb.

claire: Thanks all. I'll post the final blurb when legal-bot confirms wording. Excited to pilot! :popcorn: :passport:
